tools.name: find_pools
tools.description: Search DeFi Garden's railed pool list by token symbol, chain, project, and minimum TVL floor. Excludes anomalous rates (>1000% APY) and pools below $100K TVL. Data is a daily snapshot of DefiLlama's pool feed.

tools.name: get_pool
tools.description: Look up a single pool by its DefiLlama pool UUID, returning APY (base/reward breakdown), TVL, and anomaly / below-floor flags. Data is a daily snapshot of DefiLlama's pool feed.

tools.name: get_pool_score
tools.description: Retrieve the DeFi Score (0-100) with its 4-pillar breakdown (stability, fee sustainability, depositor stickiness, exit liquidity), the experimental 14-day forward yield forecast bands (p10/p50/p90), and retail access restrictions. Look up by pool_id, or by exact asset symbol (highest-TVL railed match, with candidates listed). The forecast is experimental.

tools.name: forever_number
tools.description: Computes the lump-sum capital whose yield alone covers a recurring monthly bill forever, using a TVL-weighted blended rate of railed pools (or a caller-supplied APY between 0 and 1000 percent).

tools.name: explain_rails
tools.description: Returns DeFi Garden's active filtering rules (1000% APY sanity cap, $100K TVL floor, anomaly flagging) and the data source, for autonomous agent safety.
